label: Sun-dried cheese
note: Not pressed and not ripened: it is dried in the open air until hard and stored dry.

about.text: Cheese set with rennet and dried hard in the sun instead of being pressed and ripened, so it keeps through the dry season. Best documented is tchoukou of Niger, made by Fulani, Hausa and Tuareg women from raw cow's or goat's milk.

facts.v: Calcium 898–1168 mg/100 g, zinc 2.9–5.2 mg/100 g (7 samples)
13 market samples: 2 satisfactory, 6 acceptable, 5 unsatisfactory (faecal contamination in some)
